rows.title: Colorado antitrust trial in Kroger-Albertsons merger has King Soopers’ parent dangling 10% price drop
rows.standfirst: Kroger and Albertsons say they face more competition from Walmart, Costco and Amazon than each other. State’s case worries about the lack of choice in rural Colorado if merger proceeds.

rows.title: Jobs, programs are cut at two Colorado mental health centers amid Medicaid “unwind”
rows.standfirst: WellPower is slashing a virtual therapy program and part of its co-responder unit, while Jefferson Center cuts 25 jobs

rows.title: What’s Working: Colorado’s misery index shows we are less miserable, though it may not feel like it
rows.standfirst: Data says one thing, life says another. There’s an impact from high inflation but how long will it take to forget? Plus: Rent updates, concerning job news, $1 for Dish and more!

rows.title: Albertsons brand would no longer exist in Colorado after merger with Kroger
rows.standfirst: Most Albertsons-owned stores, branded as Safeway, will be sold to C&S while King Soopers parent, Kroger, picks up just 14. Week two in Colorado antitrust trial begins.

rows.title: Denver’s 16th Street Mall aims to finish construction by summer 2025
rows.standfirst: The city’s biggest promoter of downtown shares the achievements but also remaining challenges to get downtown Denver back to full operations

rows.title: A Colorado ski town found an answer to its affordable housing crisis. Then voters shut it down.
rows.standfirst: A referendum that scuttled a $24M housing plan raised a thorny question in Steamboat Springs: Who gets to live in Colorado’s idyllic mountain towns?

rows.title: What’s Working: Denver-area inflation slows again to 1.4% in past 12 months
rows.standfirst: Consumers still feel price pain, though. Plus: United Airlines hires 500, WMD Squared picks the Springs & readers share how to leave inflation behind

rows.title: A 20-year quest to bring back Colorado’s rarest apple that was once thought lost
rows.standfirst: Unfortunately, the first tastes of the Colorado Orange apple have been … lackluster. But farmers say the trees just need more time.

rows.title: In Colorado, Safeway would be owned by 2 companies post merger. Neither would be Albertsons.

rows.title: Xcel efficiency rebate program resumes after regulators OK money transfer from 2025 budget
rows.standfirst: Colorado regulators weighed rewarding poor budget management but were more concerned about disrupting the industry that businesses use to green their work

rows.title: Colorado-based Ball Corp. subsidiary settles race-based hiring discrimination suit in Georgia

rows.title: What Kroger’s CEO meant when he said he never thinks about raising prices
rows.standfirst: As prosecution in Colorado’s antitrust case to block the Kroger-Albertsons merger rests, King Soopers’ parent starts its defense

rows.title: United Airlines has added 500 employees in Denver, Colorado Springs. Even more are coming.
rows.standfirst: Nationwide, United’s added 7,000 people this year, including pilots and flight attendants.

rows.title: Regulators passed sweeping rules to mitigate impacts of oil and gas drilling. Will they protect Coloradans?
rows.standfirst: No one is really happy with the cumulative impact rules lauded by the Colorado Energy and Carbon Management Commission as “a big step forward”

rows.title: Ballot Issue 2R: A Denver sales tax hike could generate $100M a year for affordable housing
rows.standfirst: Denver city officials say Ballot Issue 2R could generate upward of 40,000 affordable units over the next decade

rows.title: Molson Coors overhauls its aging facility with new 200,000-square-foot “cellar” to continue its Golden legacy
rows.standfirst: A new facility, five years and hundreds of millions of dollars in the making, is ready to churn out its first batches of beer

rows.title: State orders Mollie Kathleen mine to halt all tours after guide killed, 23 trapped underground
rows.standfirst: A cease and desist letter, signed Wednesday, ordered owners to restrict public access except for law enforcement and inspectors investigating the Oct. 10 incident

rows.title: What’s Working: Ballot measures in three locations could help rural women bring home the bacon
rows.standfirst: Voters in rural Colorado will consider measures to levy lodging taxes for child care to help working families. Plus: More union efforts at Casa Bonita, Colorado’s ‘coolest thing’ and more!

rows.title: Ballot Issue 2Q: A Denver sales tax increase that could provide a lifeline for Denver Health
rows.standfirst: The proposed tax increase would raise $70 million a year in the hopes of stabilizing the city’s safety net hospital and health system

rows.title: By the numbers: Colorado’s antitrust trial to block the Kroger-Albertsons merger

rows.title: Google, Microsoft seem OK with Colorado’s controversial AI law. Local tech not so much.

rows.title: Coloradans can now compare hospital prices for specific procedures, insurance plans
rows.standfirst: ColoradoHospitalPrices.com allows users to compare prices across multiple hospitals. It launched a month after the state debuted a similar tool.

rows.title: Future of Colorado Safeway stores up to Denver judge as antitrust trial over merger ends

rows.title: Colorado’s housing shortage is contributing to children entering foster care

rows.title: Colorado Springs Airport gets $8 million grant to modernize interior
rows.standfirst: The airport is updating its flooring, charging stations and more while also adding new food and retail options.

rows.title: Tri-State won $2.5 billion to close coal plants, get new renewable energy for rural customers
rows.standfirst: Officials say the funds will deliver 1,280 megawatts of renewable energy, more than 100 megawatts of energy storage and 2,000 new jobs in the West

rows.title: Techstars plans return to Boulder with a whole new look after its departure fractured the entrepreneur community
rows.standfirst: Techstars Colorado will be a partner — but not owned or controlled by — the original tech accelerator that started in Boulder but left town and ended its local program this year.
